===General Trivia=== * Is the younger brother of DotA 2 player [https://liquipedia.net/dota2/Ryze Ryze]. * Nicknamed ''Baby [[Faker]]'' by fans. ** Fans also call him '''Craps''' when he plays badly, and '''Claps''' when he plays especially well. ** In China he is called 帽皇 meaning ''King of Hats'' (aka King of Caps).[https://youtu.be/o7JxsPe0x3o Chinese nicknames for Western LOL pro players] ''youtube.com'' ** In Vietnam, he is called Soobin Hoàng Caps, due to his similar appearance to a popular singer [https://www.oneesports.vn/lmht/nhung-nguoi-con-xa-xu-g2-esports-duoc-cong-dong-game-thu-viet-tung-ho-sau-tran-thang-lich-su/] ''oneesports.vn'' * His father frequently attends his games, including traveling to Vietnam and Taiwan to see his son win the [[2019 Mid-Season Invitational]]. * As of July 2021, became famous for his shaved head. * Frequently says Champion quotes out loud when picking or banning a Champion. |-| Notable achievements and statistics= ===Notable achievements and statistics=== * He and [[Uzi (Jian Zi-Hao)|Uzi]] are the only two non-Korean players to have appeared in consecutive [[Worlds]] finals. * Reached 1000 kills in the LEC on June 12, 2020. ** The 5th player to reach 1000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]], [[Jankos]], [[Perkz]], and [[nukeduck]]. ** His 1000th kill was on [[MAD Lions]] in [[LEC/2020 Season/Summer Season|LEC 2020 Summer]] with {{ci|Zoe}}. * Reached 1500 kills in the LEC on April 3, 2022. ** The 3rd player to reach 1500 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]] and [[Jankos]]. ** His 1500th kill was on [[Misfits Gaming|Misfits']] jungler [[Shlatan]] in the [[LEC/2022 Season/Spring Playoffs|LEC 2022 Spring Playoffs]] with {{ci|Cassio}}. * Reached 2000 kills in the LEC on January 29, 2024. ** The 2nd player to reach 2000 kills in the LEC after [[Rekkles]]. ** His 2000th kill was on [[Fnatic|Fnatic']] top laner [[Oscarinin]] in the [[LEC/2024 Season/Winter Season|LEC 2024 Winter Season]] with {{ci|Akali}}.}. * Reached 2500 kills in the LEC on May 10, 2025. ** The 1st player to reach 2500 kills in the LEC. * Reached 2500 assists in the LEC on April 21, 2023. ** The 7th player to reach 2500 assists in the LEC after [[Hylissang]], [[Jankos]], [[VandeR]], [[Mikyx]], [[Rekkles]], and [[Odoamne]]. * Became the 3rd player to reach both 1000 kills and 2500 assists in the LEC on April 21, 2023 after [[Jankos]] and [[Rekkles]]. * Reached 300 wins in the LEC on July 30, 2023. ** The 4th player to reach 300 wins in the LEC after [[Jankos]], [[Rekkles]], and [[Hylissang]]. * Reached 400 wins in the LEC on May 10, 2025. ** The 1st player to reach 400 wins in the LEC. * Reached 500 games in the LEC on June 22, 2024. ** The 6th player to reach 500 games in the LEC after [[Jankos]], [[Hylissang]], [[Rekkles]], [[Odoamne]], and [[Mikyx]]. * Reached 600 games in the LEC on August 18, 2025. ** The 4th player to reach 600 games in the LEC after [[Jankos]], [[Hylissang]], and [[Mikyx]]. * Reached 500 international kills during [[2023 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2023]] on May 4, 2023 on Day 3 of Play-In, becoming the 4th player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]], [[Perkz]], and [[xiaohu]]. * Reached 1000 international assists during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on June 27, 2025 in Play In Round 1 against [[FURIA]], becoming the 6th player to achieve this milestone after [[Ming (Shi Sen-Ming)|Ming]], Faker, [[xiaohu]], [[meiko]], and [[Keria]]. * Reached 100 international wins during [[2025 Mid-Season Invitational|MSI 2025]] on June 30, 2025 against [[GAM Esports]] in Play-In Lower Bracket, becoming the 3rd player to achieve this milestone after [[Faker]] and [[xiaohu]]. * Reached 200 international games during [[Worlds 2025 Main Event|Worlds 2025]] on October 30, 2025 in G2's first game against [[Top Esports]] in Quarterfinals, becoming the 2nd player to achieve this milestone after Faker. * Holds the most LEC Finals MVPs (x7). * Holds the most LEC titles (x17), after winning [[LEC/2023 Season/Summer Season|LEC 2023 Summer]] and surpassing previous holder [[Perkz]] (x8). * Holds the most domestic championships won in any competitive region, with 18 as of 2026 (LEC x17, TCL x1). |-| Equipment = === Equipment === * Screen: AOC AG251FZ * Mouse: Logitech G G403 * Keyboard: Logitech G Pro X * Mousepad: Logitech G G640 * Chair: Secret Lab * Webcam: Logitech Streamcam |-| Individual Awards= ===Individual Awards=== * x1 MSI MVP (2019) * x3 LEC Split MVP (Summer 2018, Spring 2019, Summer 2020) * x1 LEC Season MVP (2024) * x7 LEC Finals MVP (Summer 2020, Spring 2022, Winter 2023, Season Finals 2023, Spring 2024, Summer 2024, Versus 2026) * x11 LEC All-Pro 1st Team (Spring 2018, Summer 2018, Spring 2019, Summer 2019, Summer 2020, Spring 2021, Summer 2021, Winter 2023, Summer 2023, Winter 2024, Spring 2024) * x4 LEC All-Pro 2nd Team (Summer 2017, Summer 2022, Spring 2023, Spring 2026) * x2 LEC All-Pro 3rd Team (Spring 2020, Spring 2025) * x1 TCL Finals MVP (Summer 2016) {{PlayerStatsTrivia}} == Tournament Results == {{PlayerResults|show=overviewpage}}
